The track "bigger thën everything" ended up releasing as a single on August 10, 2023.
Yeat confirmed in an Instagram Story on December 9, 2023 that the album would have 25 songs. In a later story, he said there could be 26, then in another he said maybe 27.

albums.name:
???
(GEEKY)
albums.description: On April 15, 2026 at 4:52:27 AM, Yeat posted to X (formerly Twitter): "im ngl i made 53 song past 48 hours." This would suggest Yeat recorded 53 tracks across April 13, 2026 at 4:52:27 AM until April 15, 2026 at 4:52:27 AM. May include production from Trgc, as Yeat followed up in another post at 5:07:17 AM: "trgcmadedat". He later followed up same day at 4:22 PM, quoting the 53 track post in another post captioned "i" in which he showed a cropped [untitled] screenshot of an album (where only the last three letters "EKY" were visible) that showed 63 tracks and a total duration of 2 hours and 53 minutes, suggesting another 10 tracks were recorded.
